title: Timetable | Yoga Momente Coburg
description: Timetable of Yoga Momente in Coburg: yoga at Tanztraum on Wednesdays (in person and online) and Early Morning Yoga online on Fridays. Drop-in.

sections.title: Timetable
sections.lead: Your weekly yoga timetable in Coburg and online.

sections.title: Your weekly timetable.
sections.lead: Both classes are drop-in: you decide from week to week whether you join.
sections.note: **By arrangement:** Hormone Yoga (as its own course or a single class) and Personal Yoga (one-to-one class). Write to us and we will find a time.

sections.title: Varied and for everyone.
paragraphs: The classes are based on the needs of the participants and alternate between flowing vinyasa sessions, deep stretch, yin and fascia yoga.
They suit beginners and advanced practitioners alike. Props such as bolsters, blocks and straps are used in every class.

sections.title: Time for your class?
sections.text: Would you like to try a class or arrange a single session? Just write to us.
